description: List of men's names organized according to family name (e.g. Castro, Romano, Qudsī, Ṭawīl, Tājir, Kohen). Dating: 16th-century or later based on the paleography, but this estimate can likely be narrowed through further research on the names mentioned. Communal rabbis (חכם) are listed first among the opening lines.
description_he: רשימת שמות גברים מאורגנת לפי שם משפחה (למשל Castro, Romano, קודסי, טוויל, תאג'ר, כהן). מאוחר.
